era_briefs.1980s: Warm wood-grain driver, restrained chrome clubs and simple blade putter; plain paper tee pack; pastel polos, pleated/straight bottoms and classic leather-look shoes; dark bag with brown trim.
era_briefs.1990s: Dark compact metalwood appearance, clear cavity-back iron, silver blade putter; simple coloured tee pack; block-colour polos and conservative bottoms; padded two-tone bag.
era_briefs.2000s: Larger silvery metal driver appearance, broader cavity iron and rounded mallet; bolder packaged tees; sporty panel/stripe apparel details and clean neutral bottoms; structured carry/stand bag.
era_briefs.2010s: Black/white aerodynamic-looking driver, clean geometric iron inset and broad mallet; bright accent tee pack; blue/coral sport polos with coordinated shoes; blue/white bag with restrained bright trim.
era_briefs.2020s: Sleek matte-black/carbon-look forms, restrained muted accents and clean premium club silhouettes; coordinated modern tee pack, streamlined outfit flat-lays and contemporary carry-bag styling.
